title: Open Mic & Jam Session @ Story Coffee Bellevue
event_description: Bi-monthly open mic hosted by XAMA featuring musicians of all levels and instruments. Hosted on 2nd and 4th Saturdays. Performers encouraged to bring own instruments and amps. Community-focused casual music gathering in coffee shop setting.
event_venue_information:
Story Coffee Bellevue - Community Open Mic Venue

Story Coffee Bellevue located at 11011 NE 9th Street is a community coffee shop that hosts regular open mic and jam sessions organized by XAMA (local musicians and music organization). The venue provides a casual accessible space for musicians of all skill levels and musical backgrounds.

XAMA Open Mic Format

Every 2nd and 4th Saturday from 7-9pm XAMA hosts open mic at Story Coffee Bellevue. The focus is on all genres instruments and skill levels - everyone is welcome. Performers are encouraged to bring their own instruments and amps. The informal coffee shop setting creates a welcoming judgment-free environment ideal for beginners and experienced musicians alike.

Community Music Focus

XAMA operates with a philosophy that music brings people together. The organization believes in making music accessible to everyone regardless of skill level background or musical preference. By hosting at an accessible coffee shop venue rather than a bar XAMA creates an all-ages space for music community building.

Parking & Accessibility

Story Coffee Bellevue is located in a commercial area with convenient parking. The Alley 111 parking garage is nearby and validates parking when you bring your ticket. The coffee shop is easily accessible by car or public transit from throughout the Seattle metro area.

Music Community

Story Coffee Bellevue has become a gathering place for the Bellevue and Seattle area music community. Regular attendees describe it as a welcoming open-minded community focused on making music together rather than performing for judgment. New musicians are encouraged to attend and participate.
